items.raw_excerpt: From the killer shark of "Jaws" to the tornado-tossed predators of the "Sharknado" movies, films have long portrayed sharks as objects of summer fear. But when a shark cuts through the waters off the US East Coast, it now may be doing more than hunting. It may also be gathering data that helps scientists understand
